description: This Java source file defines the TbRuleEngineProcessingStrategyFactory class, which creates processing strategy instances for handling message processing in the Thingsboard rule engine, including retry and skip strategies.

classes.name: TbRuleEngineProcessingStrategy
classes.description: Interface for processing strategies used in the rule engine.

classes.name: TbRuleEngineProcessingDecision
classes.description: Class representing the decision outcome of processing analysis.

classes.name: TbRuleEngineProcessingResult
classes.description: Class encapsulating the result of message processing, including success, failed, and pending message maps.

classes.name: TbRuleEngineProcessingStrategyFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating different message processing strategies, including retry and skip strategies.

classes.name: SkipStrategy
classes.description: Implementation of a skip processing strategy that skips reprocessing based on failure or timeout.

classes.name: RetryStrategy
classes.description: Implementation of a retry processing strategy with configurable retry logic, failure thresholds, and backoff.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new processing strategy instance based on the provided ProcessingStrategy type.

methods.name: analyze
methods.description: Analyzes the processing result to determine whether to reprocess messages or skip, based on strategy.

methods.name: isSkipTimeoutMsgs
methods.description: Indicates whether timeout messages should be skipped in the strategy.
